title: Copy - Paste BoneAttachment3D in Editor will select correct bone in dropdown but won't really link it
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.7.stable.mono.official [5b4e0cb0f]



### System information

Windows 10, Godot 4.7, GeForce RTX4070 ti

### Issue description

Copying a BoneAttachment3D from a scene to another (in the Editor) will work, pasting the BoneAttachment3D with it's children nodes. It will show the "Bone Name" and "Bone Idx" properly populated. But when running the project, during runtime, an error will be thrown on each frame saying:

`get_bone_global_pose: Index p_bone = 135 is out of bounds (bone_size = 133)`
` <C++ Source>  scene/3d/skeleton_3d.cpp:571 @ get_bone_global_pose()`


Unfortunately the error is not explicit at all and one will think that there is an issue with the animation(s) or model. It's really difficult to track and consumes many hours to figure out.
I believe It's easy to fix and **I can attempt to write the code for it and share it with you if you consider it of help** (just let me know).

Thanks a lot!

### Steps to reproduce

Having a working Scene: character model ("Character1_version_A"), with a Skeleton3D and a BoneAttachment3D ("MyBoneAttachment", with a Bone properly assigned):

- In Godot Editor import a new version of the model ("Character1_version_B").
- Copy BoneAttachment3D "MyBoneAttachment" from "Character1_version_A"
- Paste BoneAttachment3D "MyBoneAttachment" to "Character1_version_B"
- Run Project
